description.value:
Duration constant

Every hit you took for somebody else is still in your body, and it turns out that is a resource.

You gain 1 Tally each time you redirect an attack onto yourself and it deals damage to you, to a maximum of 3 Tally per encounter from this feat. Tally gained this way may exceed your cap and is lost at the end of the encounter if unspent.

cinderfall.incomplete: Gain 1 Tally per redirected-and-landed attack, max 3/encounter. Deadhand's Tally is entirely homebrew with zero schema footprint anywhere in this corpus.
